title: BioChirp: database-first biomedical retrieval over 11 curated databases with MCP integration
description: BioChirp is a database-first biomedical question-answering system covering 11 curated databases (TTD, CTD, HCDT, HPO, ClinVar, Reactome, MSigDB, Orphanet, STRING, UniProt, and Open Targets) through a shared schema-grounded entity-resolution and query-planning pipeline, plus a live web-search fallback for questions outside the curated set. It exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (12 tools: one per database plus web search) for direct use from Claude and other MCP clients, alongside a hosted chat interface.
